title.en: kraina koni, the christmas fair at partynice.
title.de: kraina koni, der weihnachtsmarkt in partynice.

line.en: the horse-themed christmas fair opens at the partynice racecourse at 10:00 and runs until 20 december, thursday to sunday.
line.de: der pferdethemen-weihnachtsmarkt öffnet um 10:00 auf der rennbahn partynice und läuft bis 20. dezember, donnerstag bis sonntag.
line.tr: at temalı noel pazarı saat 10:00'da partynice hipodromunda açılıyor ve 20 aralık'a kadar perşembeden pazara açık.

sparks.why: Kraina Koni christmas fair at Wrocławski Tor Wyścigów Konnych Partynice, starts Sat 28.11 at 10:00, runs to 20.12 Thu-Sun (wroclaw.pl event listing 1417516).
